errors.evidence: The color mapping is incorrect. In the legend, TDNN-HMM is orange (橙色), not red (红色); LSTM-HMM is grey (灰色), not yellow (黄色); and End-to-End is yellow (黄色), not orange (橙色).
In Test1, the bar for 'End-to-End' (yellow) has a value of approximately 12.5%, not 29%. The value 29% is closer to the value for 'TDNN-HMM' (orange), which is approximately 30.5%.
The description omits the label for the x-axis, which is '测试集' (Test Set).

The description fails to mention the main trends and comparisons shown in the chart, which is a key part of its purpose. For example, it does not state that the TDNN-HMM model consistently has the highest EDR, while the LSTM-HMM model has the lowest.
